title: Request
description:
One request: starts a worker and its first run.

Unknown fields are rejected, so a misspelled field is an error and not a
silently ignored setting.

answer_schema.description:
A JSON Schema the final answer must satisfy; asks for a structured
answer and validates it.

cwd.description:
Working directory of the worker. Absent means the working directory of
the process that receives the request. A relative path resolves against
that same directory: the caller's working directory for the command
line, the MCP server's working directory for MCP.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Absent keeps the provider default.

instructions.description: Extra system instructions for the worker.

model.description: Provider model name or alias. Absent keeps the provider default.

name.description: A label for the worker, unique among live workers.

native_args.description: Provider options passed through, restricted by an allowlist.

prompt.description: The assignment, sent to the provider on stdin.

schema_version.description:
The contract version this request was written against. Defaults to the
current version, so tool arguments need not carry it. A request file
must carry it; that is enforced by [`super::partial::PartialRequest`].

session.description: Whether to keep or continue provider history.

timeout_secs.description: Limit for the run, in whole seconds. Defaults to 600 (10 minutes).

Effort.description: How much reasoning effort to ask the provider for.

Mode.description: How much a worker may do in its working directory.

oneOf.description: May read the working directory; no writes and no commands.
May edit files in the working directory.

OnRequest.description: What happens when the provider asks for something that was not granted.

oneOf.description:
Answer no at once and record the request in the result. The only
choice in this version; asking the caller comes later.

Permissions.description: The permissions part of a request.

commands.description: Shell commands the worker may run, matched exactly.

directories.description: Extra directories the worker may read.

mode.description: How much the worker may do. Defaults to `read`.

on_request.description: What happens to a request that was not granted. Defaults to `deny`.

strict.description:
Refuse the run before it starts when the provider cannot enforce part
of these permissions as stated. Defaults to `false`, where the run goes
ahead and a provider note says what is wider than requested.

Provider.description: The provider CLI that runs the assignment.

Session.description: How the provider session is kept or continued.

ephemeral.description: Do not keep provider history for this worker.

resume.description:
Continue saved history, by the provider's own session id, in a new
worker. Cannot be combined with `ephemeral`.
